output.reason: The changelog line [ev-1c5771548249] and PR #21722 [ev-d10a3e451a87][ev-ce220d9e2374] show only that the bundled Helm binary version was bumped to 3.17.0 (checksums plus hack/tool-versions.sh). They do not state any behaviour change, any failure, or which Helm usage is affected, so no exposure condition can be tied to a stated consequence. The proposed condition is also too narrow even for "apps rendered by Helm": it checks only spec.source.chart and spec.sources[].chart, so it misses Helm charts sourced from Git paths. To decide, we would need evidence of what changed between the previous bundled Helm and 3.17.0 and which Application configurations that change affects.
